title: Robust prediction of synthetic gRNA activity and cryptic DNA repair by disentangling cellular CRISPR cleavage outcomes
authors: Stephan Riesenberg, Philipp Kanis, Rosa Karlic, Tomislav Maricic
relevance_to_cellguide: Directly relevant caveat for the plan's primary endpoint (indel %): shows indel-only scoring systematically UNDERESTIMATES true gRNA activity because some cleavage events resolve without a scorable indel (e.g. precise re-ligation, large deletions missed by standard amplicon assays). Provides a linear model that reliably predicts synthetic (chemically synthesized, RNP-delivered) gRNA activity ACROSS CELL LINES — same synthetic-RNP delivery modality as Ito et al.'s T-cell protocol, worth comparing against the plan's DeepSpCas9/CHOPCHOP baseline.
